purpose: Experimental damage tempo comparison; no production mutation or candidate activation
excludedFromNewBattles: 464 smoke battles and small public/private sink checks; earlier old baseline observations reused separately

pveDiagnostic.warning: One unchanged, not-yet-adapted MYCONID_COLONY generator; not all raids or final PvE acceptance

confidence: Reverse sides are averaged within each independent seed. Approximate95 uses normal1.96SE of paired seed values; conservativePointwise95 uses Hoeffding. No family-wise coverage claim; screening chose confirmation cases, confirmation uses a new root. No 50/50 gate.
recommendation: 1.5 is a cautious candidate compromise, not an objectively proven optimum or authorization to activate
